purpose: Map the already-frozen MYSTIC-STATE-0074/0075 empirical accuracy budget onto the current nonprobabilistic five-state aerosol scenario set without choosing thresholds from Pandora residuals and without treating aerosol families as probabilities.

modelSetDefinition.members: native baseline plus the four frozen ASIV aerosol alternatives, each evaluated over the entire independently admitted AOD550 interval
modelSetDefinition.nearestMemberInterpretation: set-membership distance only; it does not identify the nearest family/AOD as atmospheric truth and cannot be fed back into production family selection
modelSetDefinition.extremaAndDistanceAlgorithm: CERTIFIED_AOD_SCENARIO_EXTREMA_INTERVAL_BNB_V1 plus the same predeclared model-only AOD partition for later central-value set-distance evaluation

perObservationPrimaryMetric.centralSetMissLog: minimum absolute log-distance from the measured central channel value to any member of the frozen scenario-by-AOD model set
perObservationPrimaryMetric.requiredNumericalForm: use the certified upper bound on centralSetMissLog from the predeclared model-only partition; never use a permissive lower bound
perObservationPrimaryMetric.measurementIntervalOverlap: report-only diagnostic; it is not substituted for the central residual in the inherited accuracy gates
perObservationPrimaryMetric.reasonMeasurementIntervalIsNotPrimaryGat: the historical gate used |central residual| plus a positive uncertainty allowance. Replacing it by distance to a measurement uncertainty interval would subtract uncertainty and silently make the inherited 0.20/0.25/0.60 mag gates easier.

include: Pandora absolute-scale/calibration and measurement uncertainty propagated to the final channel
pre-frozen astrophysical-background treatment uncertainty if nonzero
UTC/timing uncertainty propagated through the frozen provider
pointing altitude/azimuth uncertainty propagated through the frozen provider
site/elevation uncertainty propagated through the frozen provider
other independently documented metadata uncertainty not already represented as a model set dimension
excludeToAvoidDoubleCounting: AOD550 uncertainty already represented by the full admitted AOD interval
aerosol-family structural spread already represented by the five-state model set
ASIV interpolation-validation error as an invented independent Gaussian sigma
externalSigmaLog.combination: documented covariance is preserved within source-specific reduction; independent primitive components may be root-sum-squared only when independence is justified before opening

perObservationPrimaryMetric.signedSetMissLog: 0 when the measured central log value lies inside the certified model set to numerical tolerance; otherwise signed by whether the nearest model set lies above (+) or below (-) the measured central value. Exact/tolerance-level sign ambiguity is recorded as 0 and cannot improve the absolute-error gates.

biasGate.statistic: abs(equal-session mean signedSetMissLog) + 1.959963984540054 * SE(session mean signedSetMissLog)

sessionFirstAggregation.ifMoreThan40MetadataEligibleSessions: freeze the complete metadata-eligible universe inside the calibration-valid acquisition window before target opening; do not discard sessions because their radiance later disagrees
sessionFirstAggregation.sessionMean: arithmetic mean of conservativeSetMissMag across admitted observations in that session/channel
sessionFirstAggregation.acrossSessionP95: equal-session left-continuous empirical P95 of session means
sessionFirstAggregation.bias: first average signedSetMissLog within session; then use equal session weights for mean and sample-SD/sqrt(n) standard error

marginalStrata.sessionFirstStratumStatistic: for each session and stratum/channel first average conservativeSetMissMag for rows in that stratum; then calculate equal-session P90
